# Study 02, Experiment 1: results (generated by scripts/s2_analyze.py e1)

Intervals are 95%, from a hierarchical bootstrap with 10,000 resamples of replicates, then families, then tasks within families; contrasts are paired on replicate, family and task.

## Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct (5 replicates per level)

### Primary endpoint: success on `test_comp` (600 families x 2 tasks)

| distinct training families D | success % [95% CI] | replicate means % |
|---|---|---|
| 25 | 18.9 [15.8, 21.9] | 21.4, 21.2, 14.8, 19.2, 17.6 |
| 100 | 28.1 [25.2, 31.0] | 28.8, 26.8, 27.6, 29.8, 27.8 |
| 400 | 33.8 [28.7, 39.3] | 42.2, 28.7, 30.8, 36.8, 30.3 |
| 1600 | 37.7 [33.7, 41.5] | 39.8, 37.5, 32.9, 37.8, 40.5 |

**D = 1,600 minus D = 25: +18.9 points [+15.7, +22.2]. H1 is supported** (supported: at least +10 with the interval above zero; refuted: interval entirely below +10).
Trend: +3.11 points per doubling of D [+2.57, +3.66] (least-squares slope on log2 D).

## Pre-registered decision

- H1 supported for 0.5B with test_comp at D = 1,600 below 40%, while the 1.5B student reaches 40%: not a row of the pre-registered table; see the report.
- Largest sd of replicate means on `test_comp`: 0.056 (above 0.03, so Experiment 2 would use 8 seeds per main arm).
